title: Jobs Created by New Investments Brought in by EDB in Last Three Years, their Profile and Preparedness of Local Workforce for this Growth
what_it_is: Jobs Created by New Investments Brought in by EDB in Last Three Years, their Profile and Preparedness of Local Workforce for this Growth

sections.label: EDB investments created jobs
sections.summary: EDB attracted investments creating about 54,000 jobs over three years, mostly good paying jobs filled by locals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Over the last three years, EDB attracted investments which created about 54,000 jobs across functions, such as production, digital, business services and innovation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: These include jobs, such as software engineers, data scientists, lab technicians and consultants, and the majority of these are good paying jobs which are filled by locals.

sections.label: Bosch Rexroth training centre
sections.summary: Bosch Rexroth partnered several organisations to establish a Regional Training Centre aiming to train 1,500 workers in Industry 4.0.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: For example, Bosch Rexroth partnered Singapore Polytechnic, Singapore-German Chamber of Industry and Commerce, SSG and JTC to establish the Bosch Rexroth Regional Training Centre, which aims to train 1,500 workers in Industry 4.0 methods and technologies over the next five years.

sections.label: Calibrating foreign manpower policies
sections.summary: The Government will calibrate foreign manpower policy changes so companies access needed talent while growth creates better jobs for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Government will continue to calibrate changes in our foreign manpower policies to allow companies to access the talent and skills they need to grow our economy and to also ensure that these growth opportunities will create even better jobs for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Local share of EDB jobs
sections.summary: For EDB-attracted 2021 investments, companies project about 80% of jobs paying over $4,000 will be held by locals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If I could share about the commitments of the companies and also the incremental number of jobs that will be created when the investments are fully realised, for the investments that EDB has attracted – and I focus on 2021 and these are the companies' own projections – approximately 80% of the jobs with salaries of more than $4,000 will be held by locals.

sections.label: Training Singaporeans and fair hiring
sections.summary: Government invests in Singaporeans through education and training programmes, with measures like the Fair Consideration Framework against recruitment discrimination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Bosch and Siemens, which I mentioned in my main reply earlier, are such examples.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We will also continue investing in Singaporeans through our education system and through various continuous education and training programmes such as Adapt and Grow, the Professional Conversion Programmes and SkillsFuture initiatives, for Singaporeans to upgrade themselves and to gain the relevant skills and experience to access these new jobs that we have brought in and the new jobs that are being created.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We also have strong measures in place to ensure that Singaporeans are not discriminated against recruitment practices, such as the Fair Consideration Framework.

sections.label: Welcoming global talent, capital-intensive investments
sections.summary: Complementary global talent is necessary for business growth, and investment attraction focuses on capital- and skills-intensive rather than labour-intensive activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: At the same time, this highlights also the necessity of welcoming complementary global talent with the skills, networks and expertise to enable our businesses to grow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We are also being more focused to attract investments which are capital- and skills-intensive, rather than labour-intensive.
